rationale: Price is at 85.7% of today's range after a large gap-down open, now recovering strongly on a strong earnings beat — but the stock is already up ~7% from the session low and sitting just 1.1% below today's high with 116 minutes left. Chasing a long here risks buying near the top of a post-gap recovery with limited upside to the high and meaningful downside if the recovery stalls; a short against a strong earnings catalyst and positive momentum is equally unattractive. The risk/reward in either direction is unfavorable at this position in the range.
